# Shop

> Server-authoritative shop catalogue with soft-currency and Robux items.

- Package: `Shop` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md), [Economy](Economy.md), [Level](Level.md), [Monetization](Monetization.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Shop")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Shop`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/ShopService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Shop = GaxiaServer.Shop
```

### Functions

- `Shop.RegisterItem(id: string, def: ShopItemDef): ()`
  Add (or replace) an item. `def.id` may be left out: the item's id is always `id`. `def.grant` is required unless `def.devProductId` is set (a Robux item is granted by the product's Monetization.RegisterProduct function, never by Shop).
- `Shop.Get(id: string): ShopItem?`
- `Shop.GetCatalog(): { ShopItem }`
- `Shop.Purchase(player: Player, id: string): (boolean, PurchaseFailure?)`
  Server-authoritative purchase. Returns (ok, reason); reason is nil on success. Returns false, "not_loaded" (and checks / spends nothing) while the buyer's data is not loaded, so a just-joined player is not told "insufficient_funds". This holds for every item: a Robux item does not prompt and a free item does not grant until then.

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type ShopItem = {
    id: string,
    cost: number?,          -- soft-currency price (default 0 = free)
    currency: string?,      -- soft currency key (default "Coins")
    levelReq: number?,      -- minimum Gaxia.Level
    gamePassReq: number?,   -- must own this gamepass to buy
    devProductId: number?,  -- if set: prompt a Robux product instead of debiting
    grant: (player: Player) -> (),
    [string]: any,
}
export type ShopItemDef = {
    id: string?,
    cost: number?,
    currency: string?,
    levelReq: number?,
    gamePassReq: number?,
    devProductId: number?,
    grant: ((player: Player) -> ())?,
    [string]: any,
}
export type PurchaseFailure = "unknown_item" | "not_loaded" | "requires_gamepass" | "level_too_low"
    | "prompted_robux" | "insufficient_funds" | "grant_failed"
```
